title: REGIONAL HEALTH PROPERTIES, INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: This is a routine SEC 8-K filing for Regional Health Properties, Inc. reporting (1) the appointment of Marlie Davis as Chief Financial Officer effective May 1, 2026, with an annual base salary of $265,000, target bonus of $100,000, and equity grants of 35,000 RSUs and 35,000 stock options, and (2) the resignation of director Christopher Winkle effective May 31, 2026. The filing contains no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
